content: Ingiese matan Mexihani daolii kaishi giekui khuinane jiedene, fugughaku wilielai geizhen gieku, Hudai xianxin gieku, xilini surughaku, kha teizhi onxian gieku, fugusan kun aminne oluku, zuihou shenpan gieku enezighan jichulai pse bu daidene hulunshikude daiye.
Huda dain giese matan hulunshikude daine.
Hhezighan gon zhouidene niefa giegherezhi, asimanni nenjienni jingo giezhi, Shenlinni xianshou giezhi,
Hudai kielien gou biku, houshini famani jingo giezhi daosan kunla
zhendaoni bendase hhela erchan shinishizhi geizhen gie dane. Qinsi Hudai kewonyi pse shizijia jiere ghadazhi minminji shizheghazho.
Nie ghazha chan bousan ghurai xiidene cai osizhi tareisan kunde zoin bise Hudase fuqi irene.
Ghazhade eghesun, osun osise yama zoin widazho, kharaku ghujinlazhi zuihoude siderane.
Bijienyi orentula, ingiezhi kieliezhoma, tai qinkonla goudazhi jiuikuse chadashisei bijien hende xianxin giezho.
Hudashi gundan wituni pusho. Ta giesan wilie, pse hhei nierede oluzhi oresanlai ese matazho. Eneshi ta eqighandei shentulai zhaogu giezhi edeliuzhe ushilazho.
Bijien xiwon giese ta kienliuzhe panjisanla man gholutula niekielienji rexinde giezhi zuihoude kuru.
Ingiese ta ulie langanshizhi hhezighan xianxin giedene rennai giezhi dain giesanyi jienliesan kunlanughunyi surune.
Hudai Dain
Huda Iburaheimude dain giekude goyasene fugienii zhiizhi fayen giekui uwoshi goyane zhiizhi fayen giezhi kieliewo,
"Bi ijinyo chade fuqi olon ogizhi houdeilaichii hende olodoghane."
Ingiese Iburaheimu oloncha rennai giedene dain giesei jienliewo.
Kun fayen giekude goyasene fugienii zhiizhi fayen giene. Ene fayenyi ganzhen beighazhi soyuji zhenjindusei widaghane.
Hhezighan dain giesei jienliesan kunlade Huda goya isine ibeizi ulie bienjighakui pse qinchude mejieghane giezhi dain giedene pse fayen giezhi bouzhen giewo.
Ene ghua shiqin ulie bienjine. Huda ghudan ulie kieliene. Ingiese matan Hudai miende piile iresan kunla hende bayasuzhi melie beilasan xiwonni goude barei shidane.
Matande bisan ene xiwon hoxian matanyi ruhherde olusan chon beighaku gougoui xianli, khidunji undan wo. Dajienyi sudorodu menlienzi sudoro matanyi oroghane.
ErsaMaijixide mutun chanqiku zui fugie buwa gholudene matande oluzhi tou 1 giede sudorodu menlienzi sudoro orowo.
